'''s()l(), Han THEM WOODS ARE HAUNTED!!!!!!!''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[s()l(), Han]]
* '''Published:''' 23 July 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS7]]

* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}

== Notes ==

* Posted 'Location x3 (V)' is one Location, Location, Location (V) (Virtual Set 5); the draft had read it as 3 copies of the printed card.
* Visage Of The Emperor (unique) is posted in Starting ('visage') and again in Effects; dested as posted. The Interrupts header says 11 but lists 12; total 60.
* Original-era (V): Blaster Rack (V) (VS1); Image Of The Dark Lord (V) (VS4; the draft had dropped the V); Location, Location, Location (V) and Bad Feeling Have I (V) (VS5); Ability, Ability, Ability (V) (VS6); Bane Malar (V) (VS7).
* Posted 'mauls double stik' dested Maul's Double-Bladed Lightsaber; 'sunsdown combo' Sunsdown & Too Cold For Speeders; 'meditation theatre' Executor: Meditation Chamber; 'Zukkus in boat' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter.

== Strategy ==

just playtested this so im stil getting used to playing it

just to let u know i put in the the sunsdown because of meta it could be used for another card like the second palpy i dont have >:P

furst turn:

visage loss

pull your location

pull vader

deploy vader and his stik

if u got two force left pull they will be no match for u

second turn:

visage

pull another location

use 2 force and pull deep hatred

keep pulling your dueling cards as you need them

get the sites under your control and then use your remaining characters to hunt jedi and keep them from holding that third sight for ultimatum deep hatred should win you the duels and your charcters can hold their own youre drawing some major destiny so you should win your battles

the emperor and his guards should do some major damage i was going to put in a janus but i just traded it away....

this is my first time building a hunt down so give me some tips if i did something majorly wrong >:P

matchups

hidden base

you usually get owned by hidden base unless your very careful probe them ASAP with mauls infiltrator and put some beats on them if they try to do some ground if they do vehicles use ur sunsdown

keep in mind luke if they use luke in space hes there but hes not "there" at a battleground site

speeders:

PLAY YOU BIG COWARD!!!!! sheild rules are in effect and at the beginning itll hurt them keep them off that third battleground site and use sunsdown

TRM:

oh boy some dueling

duel and battle ITS JEDI SEASON AND THERES NO BAG LIMIT

LSC:

same thing as TRM

those are the only decks ive played against so... i cant tell you too much more

keep in mind this is a prototype so keep that in mind when youre reviewing ill post a revised version if i need to.
